title: mtf-facts schema-diff report
description: Changes between two terraform providers schema -json files, for the resource and data source types a module tree uses. Each schema file is recorded by base name and SHA-256 only, so no host path is recorded.

from.description: The schema file of the current provider version.

to.description: The schema file of the target provider version.

types.description: Every resource and data source type the tree uses, with the provider source it resolves to, sorted by mode, type and source.

changes.description: One row per change, in the order of types, then attributes before nested blocks, each by name. An added or removed block is one row; its contents are not listed.

path.description: Attribute, nested attribute and nested block names from the type down; empty for the type itself.

element.description: type: the type itself; argument: a required or optional attribute; attribute: a computed-only attribute; block: a nested block.

change.description: added: in to only; removed: in from only; deprecated: deprecated in to and not in from; newly_required: required in to (min_items above zero for a block) and not in from, absent counting as not required; absent: a type in neither file.

path.description: Base name of the file as given.
